limitations: Independent Bernoulli summands are required; the low-moment constraints are not claimed to characterize the full feasible cumulant region; older Bernoulli-sum moment literature remains a residual terminology-equivalence risk despite inspection of the closest general-moment source.
scientific_summary: For a Poisson-binomial law, the effective trial count determined by variance and skewness is bounded above by the inverse-participation trial count determined by variance and fourth cumulant, which is in turn bounded by the number of nondegenerate Bernoulli summands; sharp cumulant and Lyapunov-moment envelopes follow.
